'''Markus Dorivonn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi]] who served as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Guardian]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked with two other [[Force-sensitive]] individuals to search for a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]]. He, [[Dal Kir]] and [[Zora Sasori]] found the Well of Shadows shortly after the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive explorer, [[Kasuni Tamm]], discovered it herself. Dorivonn attempted to convince Tamm to give him the holocron, but was interupted by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Sor Venge]] and a contingent of [[stormtrooper]]s. The group was able to escape the attackers with their prize.<ref name="FaDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dorivonn appears in the introductory story and gameplay example for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] book [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
